name: Cell-Based First-Hit Ray Casting
definition: A volume rendering technique that accelerates rendering by exploiting inter-ray coherency. It stores cells encountered along the last ray in a buffer to indicate if an iso-surface portion is contained there, avoiding unnecessary intersection tests for rays visiting the same cells.
summary: Cell-Based First-Hit Ray Casting accelerates volume rendering by dividing data into macro-cells, pruning empty regions via min-max octrees, and projecting only relevant surfaces to reduce ray path lengths.
